title: Immediate implant placement combining socket seal abutment and peri-implant socket filling: A prospective case series
authors: Lilet R, Desiron M, Finelle G, Lecloux G, Seidel L, Lambert F. Clin Oral Implants Res. 2022 Jan;33(1):33 - 44. doi: 10.1111/clr.13852.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Despite its limitations, this study showed that immediate implants in the posterior region using the SSA + PISF protocol resulted in promising implant outcomes with limited hard and soft tissue dimensional changes while decreasing the overall treatment time” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
